captions: 1883: An abstract of title for land in St Andrews Major and Llandough-juxta-Penarth, 1837–1877, is compiled. The catalogue does not state which Llandough land it covers (CH-0031)
1887: Owen's Cardiff Directory lists a Williams at Great House farm, Llandough (CH-0032)
15 Dec 1887: Daniel Thomas of Penylan dies, a contractor under Lord Bute with lime kilns at Llandough. On 24 Apr 1888 a man is described as a labourer at Llandough Quarry (CH-0033)
